{{Quote|If there's anything Jabba hates more than Alkharans it's Lady Valarian. Her thugs have been skulking around lately, and Jabba's sick of it.|[[Reelo Baruk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPRB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Reelo Baruk|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Valarian Syndicate''' was a criminal organization created by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it strongly rivaled [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]] for the control of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Members of the organization were known simply as '''Valarians'''.

==Description==
{{Quote|Lady Valarian has set herself up as Jabba the Hutt's rival, though I'm not sure he cares much as he is the main power here.|[[Trehla Keelo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TFS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The First Step|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
[[File:Valarian.png|thumb|left|200px|Lady Valarian]]
The Valarian Syndicate was formed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] known as [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian]]. Her goal was to develop a powerful criminal empire throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. However, due to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] grip in most illegal activities, she admitted she had to destroy first [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's criminal organization]] in order to achieve her objective. Thus, Lady Valarian was one of the few crime lords who openly defied the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and she proclaimed herself as Jabba's chief rival on Tatooine.<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref> Beyond Jabba, the Valarians also had hostile relationships with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. On the other hand, it was allied with [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

[[File:Valarian_pilot.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A Valarian [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].]]
The Valarian gang counted numerous henchmen, enforcers, thugs, thieves, [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> smugglers,<ref name="SWG:JPP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Porcellus|Tatooine}}</ref> [[Bookie/Legends|bookies]],<ref name="SWG:JPRB" /> [[Slicer/Legends|hackers]]<ref name="SWG:JPBF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Bib Fortuna|Tatooine}}</ref> and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="SWG:SC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Smuggler|Smuggle Contraband|Lok}}</ref> It also included various kinds of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] such as [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]],<ref name="SWG" /> [[Podracing/Legends|pod racers]],<ref name="SWG:JPB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Barada|Tatooine}}</ref> and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilots.<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> Valarian special operatives were provided with old-fashioned [[Q2 hold-out blaster|Republic blasters]]<ref name="SWG:I">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Ind|Tatooine}}</ref> while Lady Valarian's most trusted agents were awarded ornate [[Dagger/Legends|daggers]].<ref name="SWG:LV" /> As Valarian was a female herself, she used to offer positions of responsibility in the Syndicate to women.<ref name="SWG:KU">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Kavas Urdano|Tatooine}}</ref><ref name="SWG:I" /><ref name="SWG:JtL" />

The Syndicate was based in the ''[[Lucky Despot]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] but also owned many facilities throughout Tatooine, including a [[Valarian Depot|smuggling depot]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]],<ref name="SWG:VH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Valarian Haul|Tatooine}}</ref> a [[Valarian Outpost|outpost]] near [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]],<ref name="SWG:JPRB" /> a [[Valarian Pod Racers Bunker|bunker]] for [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]] in the [[Lowland Basin/Legends|Lowland Basin]],<ref name="SWG:JPB" /> a [[Valarian hackers' bunker|hacker bunker]] near [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]]<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> and a [[Valarian Strategic Command Bunker|strategic command bunker]] in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]].<ref name="SWG:JPJTH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Jabba The Hutt|Tatooine}}</ref> Valarians were also very active in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. Based in a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Valarian Sun]], Valarian pilots frequently patrolled several areas of the system such as the [[Desert Sands (quadrant)|Desert Sands quadrant]], the [[Rebel Space Station|Rebel Ruins]], the [[Dragon's Spine (asteroid field)|Dragon's Spine asteroid field]], the [[Station-Star 1]], the [[Pirate's Gold]], [[Jabba's Star]] and the [[Dragon's Pearl]].<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66846&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Tatoo System}}</ref> These pilots used to fly [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s as their primary starfighter<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> but they also used [[Ixiyen-class fast attack craft|''Ixiyen''-class fast attack crafts]].<ref name="SWG:HdVr">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Hunt down Valarian replacements|Yavin system}}</ref> Beyond the Tatoo system, Valarian pilots were also present in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Karthakk system|Karthakk]] and [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin systems]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

==History==
{{Quote|Valarian has assembled a team in a pathetic attempt to mount various attacks against me.|[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], two women served as the main lieutenants of Lady Valarian: the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Ind]] and the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Kavas Urdano]].<ref name="SWG:KU" /><ref name="SWG:I" /> However, Urdano and Ind had a very conflicting relationship as both competed for getting Valarian's attention. Kavas Urdano was in charge of all Valarian's smuggling operations.<ref name="ID">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref> As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] progressed, relations between Valarian and Jabba deteriorated, and the two began continually assaulting each other's assets.<ref name="SWG:KU" /><ref name="SWG:I" />

[[File:Valarians.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A group of Valarians in the Dune Sea]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Kavas Urdano and Ind recruited a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to assist them in their operations against Jabba's organization.<ref name="SWG:KU" /><ref name="SWG:I" /> These adventurers fought a group of Jabba's enforcers came to eliminate Valarian operatives on the edge of Mos Eisley, they then rescued Lady Valarian's [[Lawyer/Legends|advocate]] [[Ysho]] from the Hutt's henchmen and later killed one of Jabba's thugs who harassed the patrons of the ''Lucky Despot''. The spacers also assassinated the traitor [[Cie Vos]]. In another mission, they tracked one of Jabba's assassins who had failed in murdering Lady Valarian but had managed to steal most of the Valarian financial records. The spacers finally killed the assassin and returned to Urdano with the sensitive information before it was delivered to Jabba. Impressed with the spacers, Lady Valarian requested them to go work for Ind.<ref name="SWG:KU" /> The adventurers rescued a Valarian's compound guard who was carrying a [[Rill (species)|rill]] casserole for Lady Valarian from a Jabba's henchman, they then killed the assassin [[Roden Venthrall]] before he could murder Valarian, they later prevented Jabba's enforcers to poison the water supplies of the ''Lucky Despot''. Meanwhile, Ind was informed that a scientist specialized in beam weapons named [[Kaum]] had been recruited by Jabba the Hutt to produce new weapons for his organization. As the scientist did not know any of Jabba's men, one of the spacers picked him up upon his arrival in Mos Eisley before Jabba's thugs and escorted him back to Ind at the ''Lucky Despot''. Unaware that he had been deceived, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Kaum began to work for the Valarian Syndicate rather than for Jabba. Thereafter, Lady Valarian tasked Ind with stealing an expensive [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Egg/Legends|egg]] that had been ordered by Jabba himself to be cooked by his [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]]. After the spacers succeeded in stealing the egg from Jabba's enforcers, Lady Valarian was so pleased that she requested Ind to have the spacers working personally for her.<ref name="SWG:I" /> Valarian had discovered that a former agent of hers, [[Una Gitori|Una Githori]], was providing Jabba with secret information and requested a spacer to kill him. She also had the spacer kill one of Jabba's [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealer, [[Soobu Javeedo]], who was encroaching on her territory. A short time later, the Whiphid realized that Jabba's prime enforcer in Mos Eisley, [[Arrud Barsoomu]], recruited local [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]] to attack the Valarians. She responded by having the spacers decimate the gang of the [[Desert Banshees]] and their leader [[Kilth Saanu]], as well as Barsoomu himself. Later, the spacers also killed the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] assassin [[Duska Murgo]] and the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] criminal [[Siron Vurn'ke]] who were sent after Lady Valarian by Jabba.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

[[File:ValarianSun.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Valarian starfighters above Tatooine]]
After the Battle of Yavin, Valarian's and Jabba's pilots battled in space for the control of the Tatoo System. During the war, both factions clashed to secure Station-Star 1, the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] connecting the planet Tatooine to the space system. However, none of the faction succeeded in capturing the station that was eventually destroyed in battle.<ref name="Sony" /> During that period of time, [[Shamdon Kree]] served as starfighter pilot trainer for the Valarians and commander of space operations.<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Lady Valarian developed a partnership with Talon Karrde, the leader of the [[Smugglers' Alliance]]. This allowed Shamdon Kree to employ Karrde's pilots in a series of missions to defend the interests of Lady Valarian's organization and against Jabba's assets throughout the galaxy. These missions included the destruction of [[Canyon Corsairs|Corsair]] starfighters in the Karthakk system, elimination of Black Sun [[Ace/Legends|aces]] in the Yavin system, escort of Valarian [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] against Hutt pirates in the Tatoo system, and destruction of an Imperial patrol in the Dantooine system. Secondary missions also included escort of transports in the Karthakk system, hijacking of Imperial transports in the Dantooine system and destruction of Black Sun fighters in the Yavin system. However, the successes of these pilots attracted the attention of Jabba who discovered the alliance between Karrde and Valarian. Rather than punishing Talon Karrde, Jabba the Hutt threatened the smuggler leader and forced him to provide the services of his skilled pilots to one of his lieutenant, [[Beissa]], against the Valarians. The subsequent attacks severely crippled Valarian's operations outside the Tatooine system. Valarian pilots suffered heavy casualties in the Yavin system<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

The same year, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] and Rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]] dispatched agents to the Valarian smuggling depot near [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] in order to search for an important cargo smuggled earlier from [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:VH" /> Around the same time, the depot was also visited by a Rebel spacer to retrieve an [[RX-8 modulator]] from the leg of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] for [[Droma Ordo]].<ref name="SWG:MR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Modulator Retrieval|Tatooine}}</ref> Meanwhile, Imperial Captain [[Jasha]] sent an operative to infiltrate the depot and plant a transmitter on a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] acquired by the Valarians in order to be sold to the Rebellion.<ref name="SWG:PT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|Plant Transmitter|Tatooine}}</ref>

[[File:ValarianOutpost.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A group of Valarian thugs roaming around Jabba's Palace]]
A short time later, Jabba's lieutenant [[Reelo Baruk]] hired a spacer to eliminate Valarian soldiers who were skulking around Jabba's Palace and other Valarians who were buying up gambling debts to Jabba.<ref name="SWG:JPRB" /> In the meantime, Jabba's cook, Porcellus, hired a spacer to steal several bottles of [[Corellian Merlot]] from Valarian pirates, who stole the shipment soon before.<ref name="SWG:JPP" /> [[Barada/Legends|Barada]], Jabba's chief mechanic, then investigated the Valarian Pod Racers Bunker because he suspected the Valarian [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] pilots to cheat. He eventually ordered the assassination of [[Doane Watki]], the podracer champion of the Valarian gang.<ref name="SWG:JPB" /> Meanwhile, Valarian hackers' bunker near Wayfar was attacked by [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna's]] henchmen because a [[Sennex]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as [[Romo Vax]] claimed they had stolen information belonging to Jabba.<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> In response, Lady Valarian eventually assembled a team of off-world specialists in order to compete with Jabba's criminal empire and possibly assassinate the Hutt. It was made of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trading specialist [[Delrice Capreese]], the [[weaponsmith]] [[Arkahn Greystar]], the slicer [[Iris Tanada Sinclair]], the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Careem]], the tactician [[Fnast Drexler]], and the assassin [[Emanon]]. However, the Hutt crime lord discovered the plot and assassinated Delrice Capreese and Lady Valarian's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Tyrok]]. The other specialists were then killed during Jabba's henchmen assault on the Valarian Strategic Command Bunker.<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />

Shortly thereafter, the Valarians stole a cargo of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] disciplinary devices from Jabba's [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]]. EV-9D9 thus sent a spacer to infiltrate the Valarian Depot to retrieve the stolen cargo. The spacer sliced a [[CLL-8 binary load lifter|binary load lifter]] to load EV-9D9's cargo in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], and then killed the shuttle's pilot, [[Rando M' Kabe|Rando M'Kabe]]. The spacer finally reprogrammed the shuttle for an automated flight to Wayfar where the cargo was retrieved by EV-9D9.<ref name="SWG:Remodeling">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Remodeling|Tatooine}}</ref> A short time later, the Valarians dispatched a group of M12-L Kimogila fighters to exfiltrate Jabba the Hutt's fugitive droid [[R3-B57]] from the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatooine system]]. However, the mission failed and all ships were destroyed by Jabba's pilots.<ref name="SWG:Runaways">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Runaways|Tatooine}}</ref>

The same year, Lady Valarian managed to corrupt one of Jabba's men to provide information on the Hutt's spice smuggling runs. This allowed the Valarians to intercept one of those spice shipments, causing Jabba to loose a lot of money. The Hutt crime lord promptly tasked one of his minions, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to find the culprit. Bossk then recruited a spacer in order to attack Valarian's people and interrogate them about Jabba's shipments. The spacer finally identified the identity of Valarian's informant, tracked the traitor in the desert and killed him.<ref name="SWG:VM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Valarian's Mistake|Tatooine}}</ref>

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Lady Valarian infiltrated her lover, the Whiphid [[J'Quille/Legends|J'Quille]], into Jabba's organization with the objective to assassinate the Hutt crime lord. Although J'Quille failed in his mission, Jabba was [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|killed]] soon thereafter.<ref name="LUPTWT">{{StoryCite|story=Let Us Prey: The Whiphid's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> After the death of Jabba the Hutt, Lady Valarian finally managed to take the control of all Jabba's operations in and around [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Valarian Syndicate appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
